scope: F10 selected photo-album home scene, prompt, record, references and selection metadata.

visual_review.scene_and_action: Clear at-home photo-album scene; one hand naturally presents a landscape print and the other rests on the album.
visual_review.identity_and_expression: Black bob, silver pin, grey eyes and closed-mouth smile remain consistent with P1/P2 and U1.
visual_review.wardrobe: Selected rounded-collar long-sleeve bolero and plaid skirt are retained; no indoor footwear is present.
visual_review.sock_material: Both grey rib-knit socks read as opaque cloth with continuous rounded toe silhouettes and no individually articulated toes.
visual_review.limitations: Ankle and forefoot folds are somewhat stronger and more numerous than the preferred restrained F09 example.
visual_review.method: Original-resolution PNG compared with viewed P1/P2/U1/L1/F09 detail and inspected F09/A16-E1-1 support.
